method: Re-established the year totals, sequence and choice from the dated TER, then read the course descriptions and dated thesis entry before reconsidering the revised work against the actual UCR workbook, cache and audience fields.
findings: The ordinary English-taught degree has 60 EC in each year. The 15 EC project spans two blocks and is counted once. GIS, Statistics 2 and both research methods units precede it. The 30 EC choice block is approved open space with a 10 EC first-year elective cap. Landscapes requires fieldwork.

The closest programme uses spatial methods, water, social inquiry and policy. The climate option develops hazard and delta adaptation and adds coastal ecological and energy evidence. The governance option pairs one applied spatial course with planning-related institutions, economics and participation. All three include Spatial Planning within the scope of its documented GIS and applied projects. No course is claimed to replace a design atelier. The differences are 75, 67.5 and 127.5 EC in each direction.

The official course descriptions substantiate GIS, water, physical geography, research methods and governance partial matches. Groningen Environment and Planning studies decentralised and centralised policymaking, so Public Policy Analysis has a bounded connection. UCR consumer design is not retained as a substitute for Power of Design. The mobility, specialist design, engineering and thesis components remain distinct.

The normal comparison shows all three concepts, 23 comparator components, all selected course titles and 43 descriptions, and verified progression, source and choice notes. Optional independent research sits alongside the thesis outside scheduled credits.
